tasks.original_prompt:
Did anyone follow up on this patient's low hemoglobin? I want when it first came back low, the recheck, and whether the latest is still low.
Context: patient MRN SYN-e62a1281dd (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-09-21, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"low": ..., "rechecked": ..., "recheck": ..., "recheck_ordered": ..., "latest": ..., "still_low": ...}. low is the first result of the most recent run of consecutive low results, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit). rechecked (boolean) is whether any result is dated after low. recheck is the first result after low (same keys), and recheck_ordered (YYYY-MM-DD) the authoredOn date of the ServiceRequest its basedOn references; both null when not rechecked. latest is the most recent result (same keys) and still_low (boolean) whether it is low. Every field is null when no result is low. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (low, the recheck and its ServiceRequest, and latest; when no result is low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

tasks.original_prompt:
Check this patient's latest hemoglobin. If it's low, create a follow-up task on the report it came back on; otherwise change nothing.
Context: patient MRN SYN-e62a1281dd (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2023-10-08, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ..., "task_created": ...}. latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low; both are null when no result was ever low. Only when still_low is true, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $report with the DiagnosticReport whose basedOn references the ServiceRequest the latest result's basedOn references and whose result lists the latest result: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$report"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, and its DiagnosticReport when you create the Task; when no result was ever low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
